text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day... a moment of tension had 
arrived for North Flight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up until today, North Flight had been 
training carefully, prioritizing 
conditioning her body first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it went well or not... and whether 
she can run in demanding races going 
forward... The test results will tell us.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list:
Let's believe in who we've become up to 
now.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let me share your test results 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
“—Her body is in fantastic shape! She'll 
definitely be able to run just like the 
others!”

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work up to today. 
Taking things slow and steady must have 
been mentally frustrating at times.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
This is the result of both of you 
sincerely listening to your bodies. 
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes...! ...Yes!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“—That said, intense training should only 
be introduced gradually, as discussed.”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I can't let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even as she said that, North Flight 
seemed quite thrilled. And frankly, so was 
I.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu. So, we will be the ones.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Because I was with you, Trainer, I was 
able to do my best.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The real runway starts here! Right now, 
I've only just spotted the starting line.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I've gotta grow at 
blistering... Bakushin speed!
choice_data_list:
Summer camp is right around the corner 
too.

Summer camp is right around the corner 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy holds summer training camps 
to help students improve their skills. It 
provides an environment where Umamusume 
who show remarkable growth in summer can 
truly focus.
choice_data_list: You can become even stronger, you know

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, would you like to go 
shopping on the way back?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now I just want to go look for an outfit 
that fits my current mood perfectly♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, when we stepped out into town—

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Are you... Flight-chan, by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan
text_block_list.text: T-The real thing...! So cute!

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan
text_block_list.text: Ah, I-I'm... I-I'm a huge fan of yours!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh, my...!

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan
text_block_list.text:
"I just happened to see your Debut race... 
and it caught my attention."

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Her racewear is super gorgeous, and her 
casual clothes on Umastagram are so cute 
too... Before I knew it, I had become a 
huge fan!"

text_block_list.name: Flight Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, from now on... may I cheer on your 
running lots and lots?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
From here on out— I'll show you plenty of 
my brilliance!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy, you know. To have people 
expect things of me..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Big Sister, myself, and Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
There were people who believed in me. 
But... there were more people who didn't.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There's someone placing their dreams 
in me...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
We've got to live up to their 
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight gazes up at the sky. Beyond 
her gaze, she must be picturing the 'Shuka 
Sho.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. I have a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I really want to get good results at the 
Shuka Sho. I want to live up to everyone's 
support..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm not confident in distances 
beyond 1600m. I want to get thoroughly 
used to them.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
As I am now, I should be able to take on 
races with shorter intervals between them.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Do you have any 
recommended races?
choice_data_list:
Then... how about the Fuchu Umamusume 
Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than jumping straight into a 2,000m 
race like the Shuka Sho, it would be best 
for her to ease into it with an 1,800m 
race first.
choice_data_list:
The Shuka Sho is right around the corner, 
so don't push yourself too hard

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I don't try on clothes that 
won't fit me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to assess everything 
carefully and do my best!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then the next goal is the Fuchu Umamusume 
Stakes. And after that, the Shuka Sho... 
right!
choice_data_list: Let's prepare thoroughly at summer camp!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please take good care of me!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm... really looking forward to the 
future!
